mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goal(user_id, label_id, clock_in_time, clock_out_time, clock_in_count, target_clock_in_count, clock_in_cycle, remark) VALUES(#{userId}, #{goal.labelId}, #{goal.clockInTime}, #{goal.clockOutTime}, #{goal.clockInCount}, #{goal.targetClockInCount}, #{goal.clockInCycle}, #{goal.remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE goal SET clock_in_time = #{goal.clockInTime}, clock_out_time = #{goal.clockOutTime}, remark = #{goal.remark}, label_id = #{goal.labelId}, target_clock_in_count = #{goal.targetClockInCount}, clock_in_cycle = #{goal.clockInCycle} WHERE id = #{goal.id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM goal WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM goal WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
